excerpt_original: Thirteen scripts across feature film and TV included on the 2026 list.

blocks.text: Source: The Brit List
The Brit List 2026 selected writers
Gemma Addy’s coming-of-age feature Dig For Victory and Archie Thomson’s crime series Petroc have topped the The Brit List 2026 of unproduced screenplays from emerging UK talent.
Both projects received 25 recommendations each, with a minimum of 10 recommendations needed to make the list this year – up from seven last year.
Scroll down for the full list

blocks.text: Addy is a graduate of the National Film and Television School who has worked as a script reader for Bafta Rocliffe and story editor for Banijay France. Set in rural Wiltshire, Dig For Victory follows an isolated girl in the closing months of the Second World War, whose new friendship with an older woman is interrupted by a violent incident.
It currently has no producers attached, which is the case for six of the 13 selected projects, a lower level than 12 of 15 last year.

Thomson’s Petroc sees a charismatic Cornish outlaw return home after 12 years in prison, and set about reclaiming what he believes has been taken from his family. It will be produced by About Premium Content and Bosena, the Cornwall-based production company behind Mark Jenkin’s films.

The list also includes 15 Summers , a feature written by 2020 Screen Star of Tomorrow Courttia Newland, about a successful rapper whose teenage son joins him on tour, forcing the estranged duo together. It is one of three selected scripts for Joi Productions, the company of fellow 2020 Star Joy Gharoro-Akpojotor.

The other two are Bec Boey’s BFI-backed horror The Lambeth Worm , inspired by the Northeast folk tale; and Joan Iyiola’s legal drama series Overturn , about a high-profile murder case that threatens to unravel the career of a promising young prosecutor.
The Brit List has partnered with Disney+ as its headline sponsor for the first time this year, in the 19 th edition of the list.
The selected writers will take part in a six-month development programme of weekly seminars from industry leaders.
Writers previously selected for the list include Emerald Fennell, James Graham, Abi Morgan, Jack Thorne and Peter Straughan.
The Brit List 2026
Synopses provided by The Brit List
25 recommendations

Dig For Victory scr. Gemma Addy Producers: Available Form: Feature Genre: Coming-of-age drama Summary: In rural Wiltshire, an isolated girl comes of age in the closing months of World War II. But when a violent incident interrupts a new friendship with an older woman, she uncovers a series of secrets that will shape a deadly future.

Petroc scr. Archie Thomson Producers: About Premium Content / Bosena Form: TV Genre: Crime Summary: When a charismatic and volatile Cornish outlaw returns home after twelve years in prison, he sets about reclaiming what he believes has been taken from his family, transforming the Penroses from small-time crooks into a rising criminal power. Set against the wild Cornish coastline, Petroc is a propulsive family crime saga about loyalty, belonging and identity, and the devastating consequences that follow when the past refuses to stay buried.
22 recommendations

Do No Harm scr. Polly Findlay Producers: Hinterland Pictures / Fable Pictures Form: Feature Genre: Thriller Summary: Anna, a young doctor, accepts a voluntary night shift away from her family on Christmas Eve. When her mentor, Dr. Petersen, is called away, Anna is left in charge of an overstretched maternity ward. With the pressure mounting, she has to make a series of urgent critical decisions way beyond her experience. Just as things seem to be under control, Anna realises that she’s made a tiny and very human error that may end up costing a patient her life.
18 recommendations

Mrs. X scr. Rian Smith Producers: Available Form: TV Genre: Psychological thriller Summary: When details of her secret affair show up in a student’s homework, an English teacher must do battle with a mysterious blackmailer in this cat-and-mouse game that soon escalates to murder. Mrs. X is a twisty-turny thriller, where our lead characters – a tense-but-warm sister pairing – are always racing against the clock, trying to get one step ahead (while always being ten steps behind). The show interrogates whether we have truly thrown off the shackles of conservative thinking, or if the societal need to control others – especially women – still bubbles under the surface …
15 recommendations

The Trolley Problem scr. Polly Cavendish Producers: Imaginarium Form: Feature Genre: Psychological thriller Summary: Young married couple Nick and Georgie are involved in a horrific accident in which a stranger dies. Years later, the decisions they made during those fateful moments come back to haunt them.

15 Summers scr. Courttia Newland Producers: Joi Productions Form: Feature Genre: Drama Summary: Dimes is a successful rapper whose pursuit of fame estranges him from his teenage son, Tristian. When Tristian joins Dimes on tour, father and son are forced into close proximity, exposing resentment, disappointment, and misunderstanding. As Tristian witnesses the contradictions of his father’s world – glamour, violence and chaos – Dimes sees the young man his son is. But when a night out turns violent, and Tristian is harmed, Dimes finally confronts the life he has chosen. Over one transformative summer, both must decide whether it’s too late for them – and whether Dimes can put his son before everything.
13 recommendations

The Royal No One scr. Levi Scott Producers: Available Form: TV Genre: Comedy drama Summary: A star finance graduate with severe social anxiety discovers that secretly selling cocaine at the nightclub where he works as a busboy boosts his confidence far more than his medication. Unbeknownst to him, the club is run by gangsters who soon coerce him into becoming their in-house dealer.
12 recommendations

The Lambeth Worm scr. Bec Boey Producers: Joi Productions/BFI Form: Feature Genre: Horror Summary: Inspired by a traditional folklore tale from the writer’s native Northeast England, The Lambeth Worm tells the story of two young BESEA women who find a small creature in their tower block apartment. After washing it down the sink, the creature takes up residence in the building’s pipes. As fear spreads through the apartment block the other inhabitants become increasingly hostile and toxic, and a culture of terror and blame begins to take hold.

Baboons scr. Alfie Flewitt Producers: House Productions Form: TV Genre: Comedy drama Summary: His younger brother Ernie’s funeral brings Ned back to his East Midlands family home. As he and his parents grapple with their grief, they go from being a broken family to a healed one, finding love, pain, and a stray baboon along the way …

Hello Stranger scr. Rory Platt Producers: Available Form: TV Genre: Comedy drama/thriller Summary: When an outlaw on the run gets stranded in a sleepy Welsh village, the locals fall prey to her charms, lies … and crimes. A female-led, Western-flavoured crime thriller: Far From The Madding Crowd meets The Good, The Bad & The Ugly .

Grey Matter scr. Theo Toksvig-Stewart Producers: Available Form: Feature Genre: Psychological near-fi thriller Summary: In near-future London, humanoid care robot Blanche, built to nurse and programmed to forget, is taught to feel by her patient’s son. But the romance that awakens her soon exposes her to the dark side of devotion.
11 recommendations

Pegged scr. Rachel Tookey Producers: Available Form: TV Genre: Romcom Summary: A brocaster hiding his submissive streak. A feminist craving control over others while losing it in her own life. After clashing in a bar, they unwittingly match on Tinder under anonymous kink profiles. Their explosive chemistry – and conflicting ideologies – drag them into the weirdest, most revealing situationship of their lives.
10 recommendations

Overturn scr. Joan Iyiola Producers: Joi Productions / Miramax Form: TV Genre: Legal drama Summary: Leading prosecutor Kemi Odutola is on the brink of becoming the youngest judge ever when a high-profile murder case threatens to unravel everything she has built.
